concerns.text: SC-003 requires ΔAIC to be reported for each interaction‑augmented model (migration‑only and latitude‑only). The current task T007 fits a single model containing both interactions and records only one ΔAIC, omitting the separate ΔAIC values mandated by the specification.

SC-004 specifies that the stability of the telomere‑lifespan coefficient must be quantified (e.g., a numeric stability metric) from the LOOCV/jackknife results. Task T008 logs per‑iteration coefficients but does not compute or report a quantitative stability measure, leaving the success criterion unmeasurable.

SC-005 demands that statistical power be calculated. Task T008 performs power simulation only when n_species ≥ 15 and otherwise skips it, resulting in the success criterion potentially remaining unmet for smaller datasets.

Constitution Principle VI requires every ecological covariate (migration_status, breeding_latitude, body_mass_g) to retain a provenance field linking it to its original source identifier. The cleaning/merge task T004 merges ecological data but does not record such provenance fields, violating the non‑negotiable ecological data integration principle.
